items.description: Confirm the branch, commit, and working tree.
Confirm the intended firmware version in EepromManager.h.
Run the reproducible CLI Release build and size check, recording size evidence.
Complete the Windows/Microchip Studio Release cross-check or record the explicitly accepted branch waiver.
Run or confirm the hardware regression layer for this release candidate.
Build and validate the release package.
Verify the expected release package outputs exist under release-packages.
Draft concise GitHub release notes before tagging.
Create and push the Git tag, then create the GitHub release with required assets.
Verify the published GitHub release title, notes, tag, standalone update HEX, and ZIP.
Re-check this checklist against the work just performed before declaring deployment complete.
